Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the second search action), the WebSurfer agent included a specific date ("10/05/1912") in the search query string ("Beauchamp St John 17th Baron St John of Bletso death date 10/05/1912"). This is a critical error because the agent had not yet verified that this specific date was correct; it was merely an assumption or a guess based on incomplete information from the previous search results. By hardcoding an unverified date into the search query, the agent biased the search results and failed to follow the Planner's instruction to use exact queries without pre-supposed values to ensure unbiased corroboration. This led to the propagation of an incorrect date (May 10) over the potentially correct one (October 5) found in earlier, less specific searches.
